functionDefs.safe_parse_jsonb:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.safe_parse_jsonb(val text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
    BEGIN
        RETURN val::jsonb;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'timestamp', to_char(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
            'user', 'system',
            'action', val,
            'changes', '{}'::jsonb
        );
    END;
    $function$
